name: New Zealand Legislation API v0 - versions of the RTA (requires API key)
notes: OBSERVED 401 {"error":"API key is required"}. Official PCO API (v0 beta): /v0/works, /v0/works/{work_id}/versions, /v0/versions/{version_id}; key via X-Api-Key header or api_key query param; request a key by emailing contact@pco.govt.nz. Limits: 10,000 requests/key/day and 2,000 requests/IP/5 min. Docs: https://api.legislation.govt.nz/docs/ . Once a key is held this should replace XML polling as the primary NZ legislation signal (store the key as a GitHub Actions secret). The site's per-document RSS feeds are served from the same API and also need a key.
